However, if no claims, perhaps the whole parent requirement is unresolved. The instruction: "If several independent unresolved parts remain, choose exactly ONE coherent part. Alternatively choose the same-university condition: "Establish whether the Indian author's 2022 promotion to professor occurred at the same university where they completed both undergraduate and graduate degrees." But that presupposes the author and promotion. It's more composite. The promotion event is more basic.

Maybe local_residual: "Establish that an Indian author was promoted from associate professor to professor in 2022." That's exactly one condition. It includes Indian author. Good.
